name: quorum
description: A resolver for the A2A input-required state. Agents ask, people answer, Tempo settles.

scripts.build: tsc --build packages/gateway demo && npm run build -w @quorum/worker-app
scripts.typecheck: tsc --build --force packages/core packages/paymaster packages/gateway demo && tsc -p packages/worker-app --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run test -w @quorum/core && npm run test -w @quorum/gateway
scripts.site: npm run build -w @quorum/site && npm run dev -w @quorum/site
